trace: E9: package.replaced fires after the install, across the miri/replaced pair
clause: Agent Integration Contract 3.2, 6.1; Lifecycle and Security Metadata 9.6
note: The one trace whose event is `package.replaced`. The kind is `after` because the replacing artifact has to be installed before a local surface can read it, and agent-event-v1 accepts `after` for this kind. The consumer's side of the pair, re-deriving trust from the bytes installed now, is asserted by golden A14.

assertions.must: Emit exactly one event of this shape after the second install in a session that installs the `miri` arm and then the `replaced` arm at the same version (Agent Integration Contract 6.1).
assertions.must_not: Answer from a trust determination made about the previous bytes (MIRI-CONSUMER-052; golden A14).

why_this_case: It is the only golden that carries a package.replaced event, so it is what makes agent-event-v1 and the contract's phase rule for this kind checkable.
